page.title: Suites
page.description: Regression suites group cases across stories so you can run them again.

list.emptyDescription: Create a suite to run the same cases from many stories again every sprint.
list.emptyReadOnlyDescription: A QC or an Admin creates the project's regression suites.

detail.loadError: The suite could not be loaded
detail.notFoundDescription: It does not exist or you cannot see it.
detail.archivedDescription: It keeps its cases and its runs, but it can't be changed or run.
detail.runningTitle: A run of this suite is in progress
detail.runningDescription: A suite has one running run at a time. Start the next one when it finishes.

command.title: Run with Claude
command.description: Paste this command in Claude Code with the Tessio plugin. Claude runs the suite's Ready cases, at most 50 cases per run, and reports the results per story.
command.note: Cases that are not Ready or that need review are skipped and listed in the report.

cases.title: Cases
cases.emptyDescription: Add cases one by one, or by label, priority, story or sprint.
cases.emptyReadOnlyDescription: A QC or an Admin adds the suite's cases.
cases.instructions: Drag the handle to reorder the case, or focus it and press the up and down arrow keys.

addCases.title: Add cases
addCases.limit: A suite holds at most {{max}} cases.

filter.title: Add cases by filter
filter.description: The filter runs once. The matching cases are added at the end of the suite, and the suite keeps them as a fixed list.
filter.labelsDescription: A case must carry every label you pick.
filter.noneAdded: No new case matched the filter.

archive.title: Archive suite
archive.description: Archive "{{name}}"? It keeps its cases and its runs, but nobody can change it or run it again. A run in progress keeps running.

errors.nameAlreadyUsed: Another suite in this project already has this name.
errors.archived: This suite is archived, so it can't be changed or run.
errors.unknownReference: A case or a story could not be found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalidRequest: The suite could not be saved. A suite holds at most {{max}} cases.

runs.skippedDescription: These cases are in the suite but didn't run.

manualRun.loadError: The suite could not be loaded
manualRun.noRunnableTitle: No case of this suite can run
manualRun.noRunnableDescription: Only Ready cases that don't need review run.
manualRun.runningTitle: A run of this suite is in progress
manualRun.runningDescription: Finish it before you start another run of this suite.

errors.openGaps: Open gaps on this suite's stories must be answered before it can run. Answer them on the stories, or with /tessio:answer-gaps in Claude Code.
errors.alreadyRunning: A run of this suite is already in progress.
errors.empty: This suite has no Ready test case to run.
errors.archived: This suite is archived, so it can't be run.
